page.overview:
Who is Straal?

Straal was a Human Starfleet officer in the 23rd century.

In 2244, Straal and his research partner Paul Stamets discovered a mycelial network, based on Prototaxites stellaviatori, that spanned the universe and could be harnessed for rapid travel across vast distances. The two openly talked about the possibility of receiving the Zee-Magnees Prize when their research was completed. ()

While Stamets considered the possibility of an organic mycelial harvest based on terraforming, Straal quashed the research because he wanted to keep the crop captive. ()

When war broke out with the Klingons in 2256, Starfleet separated Straal and Stamets, and pressed them into service, developing a practical propulsion system based on their findings. Straal was assigned to lead the team on the .
